title: pp.dynamics~
description: `pp.dynamics~` is a compressor/expander for processing an audio signal, with a second signal inlet for sidechain input and a message inlet for control. It provides controls for compression and expansion thresholds, attack/release, RMS or peak envelope detection, makeup gain, dry/wet mix, lookahead, and feedback compression, and can save and recall up to 20 presets with the parent patch.
